- Gallery composition root injects the Always AdResolutionPolicy so moment-1 fires.
- LiveKernelSink/GalleryBridge: claim_ad_url + ad_url_state; snapshot decoder retains ADCL payloads. [...] - nmp-native-runtime (new nip-ad feature): Send NmpReadHost handle = ONE canonical ReadHost impl, NmpApp delegates (lets an off-thread resolve open a collection). Moment-1 AdUrlResolver impl gated by app-injected AdResolutionPolicy (default NeverAutoResolve). Moment-2 AdCandidate arm dispatches the same resolver, never gated; parallel search already fires. set_ad_resolution_policy composition seam. nip-ad enabled in nmp-app-gallery.
